items.title: J&J raises FY26 outlook following positive Q2
items.summary: Contributing around $8.9bn to its Q2 revenues of around $25.3bn, J&J MedTech’s performance was driven by its cardiovascular portfolio that includes the Shockwave IVL system.

items.title: Women’s health attracted record equity in 2025 as companies share capital
items.summary: Closing the gender gap could boost the global economy by at least $1tn annually by 2040.

items.title: AAIC26: The role of biomarkers in primary care and early diagnostics
items.summary: Blood-based biomarkers could play a key role in detecting and treating Alzheimer’s early at the first point of contact, experts say.

items.title: FDA grants priority review to Roche’s Gazyva/Gazyvaro for pMN
items.summary: The FDA has granted priority review to Roche’s sBLA for Gazyva/Gazyvaro in the treatment of adults with pMN.

items.title: Innovent licenses IBI355 rights to Spero for up to $1.1bn
items.summary: Innovent Biologics has granted Spero Therapeutics an exclusive licence deal to develop and commercialise IBI355 outside Greater China.
